info.name: Life_Share_A6
info.description:
## Life_Share_A6 — API Collection

**Life_Share_A6** is a comprehensive REST API collection for a life-sharing and emergency health services platform. It covers the full lifecycle of user interactions — from authentication and profile management to blood donation coordination, hospital bookings, emergency services, and payments.

### Modules

| Folder | Description |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | User registration, email verification, login, password reset via OTP, and refresh token generation. |
| **User** | Fetch the authenticated user's profile, update personal details, submit blood requests, and view all requesters. |
| **Donor** | Create, retrieve, update, and delete donor profiles; browse all registered donors and view individual donor details. |
| **Donation** | Manage the full donation request lifecycle — create requests, track statuses, view received requests, and allow donors to accept or decline. |
| **Hospital** | Register and manage hospital profiles, handle booking requests from users, and update booking statuses. |
| **Emergency Service** | Create and manage emergency service listings; browse all available services and retrieve service details. |
| **Booking Emergency Service** | Book emergency services, view and manage personal bookings, update booking details, and cancel or delete bookings. |
| **Payment** | Initiate payments, retrieve personal and hospital payment records, view payment details, and update payment statuses. |
| **Admin Controlled** | Administrative endpoints for overseeing all users, donors, requesters, hospitals, services, payments, and requests — including status updates and deletions. Super Admin access required for user deletion. |
| **Analytics** | Retrieve aggregated platform analytics for admin dashboards. |

### Authentication
Most endpoints require a Bearer token obtained through the **Login** or **Generate Refresh Token** requests in the Auth folder.
